name: goal_add
description: Persist a structured goal without running it (write). The goal's board card is created separately by the web UI's board mirror (kanban_add); this tool only appends the durable goal record. Never executes the goal.
llm_description: Persist a structured goal without running it. Required: "objective". Optional: "completion_criterion" (drafted by the goal loop when omitted), "proof", "boundaries", "stop_rule", "max_iterations" (integer 1..1000), "worktree" (branch/path). Returns its id. The board card is the goal's visible surface and is created/updated via the kanban_* tools.
